description: This file contains an extension for the ChannelsStore class, providing asynchronous methods to load and manage configuration schemas and values, applying UI configurations, and handling nested configuration data. It interacts with external components like GatewayConnection and ConfigStore, and provides internal utility functions for managing nested configuration paths.

methods.name: loadConfigSchema
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the configuration schema from the gateway and updates internal variables accordingly.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Fetches the current configuration snapshot asynchronously, updates internal state, and applies UI configuration.

methods.name: applyUIConfig
methods.description: Extracts and applies UI-related configuration from a snapshot, specifically updating the seam color.

methods.name: channelConfigSchema
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration schema node for a specific channel ID.

methods.name: configValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value at a specified path, with special fallback logic for 'channels' paths.

methods.name: updateConfigValue
methods.description: Updates the draft configuration at a specified path with a new value, marking the configuration as dirty.

methods.name: saveConfigDraft
methods.description: Saves the current draft configuration asynchronously, then reloads the configuration.

methods.name: reloadConfigDraft
methods.description: Reloads the current configuration by calling loadConfig.
